claims.claim: Revenue for the second quarter of fiscal 2027, ended July 26, 2026, was $96.2 billion.
Second-quarter revenue increased 18% from the previous quarter.
Second-quarter revenue increased 106% from a year ago.
GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins for the quarter were both 75.0%.
GAAP diluted earnings per share were $2.46.
Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share were $2.22.
GAAP net income for the quarter was $59,688 million.
GAAP net income for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 was $26,422 million.
Data Center revenue was $89.0 billion for the second quarter.
Data Center revenue was up 117% from a year ago.
Data Center revenue was up 18% from the previous quarter.
Edge Computing revenue for the second quarter was $7.2 billion.
Edge Computing revenue was up 27% from a year ago.
Edge Computing revenue was up 13% from the previous quarter.
The company announced the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform is entering full production, with racks running at partners including Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
For the third quarter of fiscal 2027, NVIDIA expects revenue of $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%.
NVIDIA is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in its third-quarter outlook.
NVIDIA expects GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins for the third quarter of fiscal 2027 to be 74.0%, plus or minus 50 basis points.
For full year fiscal 2027, NVIDIA expects GAAP and non-GAAP tax rates to be between 16.0% and 18.0%.
NVIDIA returned approximately $26.0 billion to shareholders during the second quarter of fiscal 2027 through cash dividends and share repurchases.
As of the end of the second quarter, approximately $99.0 billion remained under the share repurchase authorization.
The company will pay its next quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share on October 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 10, 2026.
Strategic partnerships are intended to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital for the AI infrastructure buildout.
